d:
1947 arth ab altra muvi parlar par LIVE dekhen! 1947 ke vibhajan ke dauran doston ke bikharte rishton aur dil chhu lene vale hadson ki gatha. pyar, trasdi aur atut jajbaton ki yah mashhur mastarpis abhi dekhen. puri philm dekhne ke lie abhi klik karen aur altra muvi parlar ko sabsakraib karen!
Cast : Aamir Khan, Nandita Das, Rahul Khanna, Shabana Azmi, Kimi Verma, Pawan Malhotra, Kulbhushan Kharbanda
Director: Deepa Mehta
Writer: Deepa Mehta (Screenplay), Bapsi Sidhwa (Novel "Ice Candy Man")
Cinematography: Giles Nuttgens
Music Director: A. R. Rahman
Lyrics: Javed Akhtar
